def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts={v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid) for v in {x for row in grid for x in row}}
    bg=max(counts, key=counts.get)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        cols=[c for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
        if len(cols)>=2:
            for c in range(min(cols)+1,max(cols)):
                if grid[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=3
    for c in range(w):
        rows=[r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] != bg]
        if len(rows)>=2:
            for r in range(min(rows)+1,max(rows)):
                if grid[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=3
    return out
